newsitem.title: USA: Life USA Holding encouraged by Q1 events.
newsitem.headline: Life USA Holding encouraged by Q1 events.

text.p: Life USA Holding Inc said Monday it is "encouraged" by a number of events in the first quarter of 1997, which should set a positive stage for the second quarter.

"The field's ebullient acceptance of the new IDEAL annuity, continued strong recruiting, increased production from new marketing groups and the impact of the national advertising and sales promotion campaign, all create a positive impetus for the second quarter," Robert MacDonald, chairman and chief executive of Life USA, said in a statement.

Earlier, Life USA reported first quarter earnings of $0.22 a share verus $0.21 last year. Total expenses rose eight percent, and the company said a large portion of the increase was from a national advertising and sales promotion campaign.

MacDonald said the IDEAL annuity, introduced in February despite lacking approval in several major states, was the company's third largest selling annuity product in March, accounting for 12 percent of total annuity premiums. He said it could be the top seller by the end of the year.

Life USA said more than 3,000 new agents and eight new marketing organizations joined the company. The company said it continues to aggressively pursue affiliation discussions with large marketing groups.
"While Life USA experienced a solid first quarter, if current trends continue, it may only be a precursor of even better results in the future," MacDonald said.
